required_question: After giving software every reasonable chance, would I independently spend engineering time investigating custom hardware for this remaining bottleneck?
classification_interpretation: The mandated classification set has no INCONCLUSIVE option. SOFTWARE_WINS is selected as the least overclaiming terminal disposition because software measurably removed most of the physical pathology while the integrated run produced no state-path critical-share or Amdahl evidence. It closes the custom-hardware case under the experiment's fail-closed evidence rules; it does not assert that the strict <10% critical-path-share or <1.15x ideal-free end-to-end thresholds were measured.

timings_seconds.qualification: Single instrumented PCIe-A100 micro observation. CUDA-event, SHA, synchronization, and phase wall measurements overlap and are not additive. Frozen v10 latency used SXM4 and is not directly timing-comparable.

export.chain: destination-index upload -> native index_select -> copy_repack -> D2H -> publish SHA-256

restore.chain: preflight SHA-256 -> owned host snapshot -> consumption SHA-256 -> H2D -> destination-index upload -> native index_copy -> raw-bit validation
restore.software_candidate: Fuse destination index, scatter, and raw-bit validation across larger page runs; reduce 4,480 small validation launches and synchronous scalar checks.

residual_micro_chain.interpretation: Meaningful micro work remains, but it is mixed CPU hashing, data movement, and small GPU launches. The most concrete residual is still a CUDA/software fusion target. Micro-local duration does not establish its share of reclamation, useful-capacity, SLO-restoration, or rollout-interruption critical paths.

integrated_attempt.failure: bounded backlog safety abort at 65 total outstanding before reclaim trigger
integrated_attempt.classification_impact: The failed serving transaction supplies no evidence that the residual state chain is important to HBM reclamation, useful GPU1 capacity, serving SLO recovery, restore interruption, or economics.

regular_residual_fused_chain_remains.evidence: A repeatable restore validation/scatter chain is visible, but no integrated execution occurred.

residual_chain_at_least_15_percent_of_im.evidence: No integrated v11 state path executed; important end-to-end critical-path shares are unmeasured.

realistic_acceleration_at_least_1_20x_on.evidence: Coarse micro-stage Amdahl is calculable, but every integrated economic path impact is null. The coarse stages are not isolated hardware-accelerable residual chains.

bandwidth_or_dataflow_dominated.evidence: The measured micro residual is mixed: CPU SHA-256 and many small GPU launches dominate observed components.

stable_semantics.evidence: Offline production semantics and micro correctness are stable, but no integrated serving execution of the chain was observed.

bytes_burst_rate_latency_target_and_conc.evidence: Bytes and isolated micro latency are measured; integrated burst rate, concurrency, service target, and interference are absent.

plausible_advantage_outside_normal_gpu_e.evidence: No placement or end-to-end interference measurement demonstrates an off-GPU advantage.

GPU_SOFTWARE_WINS.reason: The raw-validation/scatter residual naturally suggests CUDA/Triton fusion, but integrated critical share and the required <1.15x realistic external-accelerator end-to-end increment were not measured. Selecting this label would overstate the evidence.

BRANCHFABRIC_HARDWARE_INTEREST.reason: Forbidden by the experiment contract without measured integrated v11 timings; required critical-share, Amdahl, economics, concurrency, and placement evidence are absent.

PRESERVATION_NOT_ECONOMIC.reason: The kill/recompute arm did not run, so no measured recompute coefficient or preservation break-even exists.

amdahl_and_economics.micro_amdahl_qualification: Source, restore, and all-state stages are coarse non-overlapping measured walls, not isolated hardware-accelerable subchains. Their micro speedups cannot be relabeled as integrated or economic headroom.
amdahl_and_economics.conditional_threshold_assumptions: Kill and preserve fixed overheads are equal and measured preserve time is locally constant.
amdahl_and_economics.prohibition: No null integrated impact or kill coefficient is replaced by v10 timing, micro-local fraction, or projected bandwidth.

software_wins_qualification.why_selected_anyway: Exactly one terminal classification is mandatory and the evidence cannot support any custom-hardware, GPU-software end-to-end, or preservation-economics claim. SOFTWARE_WINS records the defensible outcome that measured software optimization survives while custom hardware does not clear its burden of proof.

independent_engineering_judgment: I would not independently spend engineering time investigating custom BranchFabric hardware from this evidence. If work continued outside this terminal experiment, I would first use ordinary software engineering to batch/fuse raw validation and reduce CPU hash/launch overhead, then demand a valid integrated timing DAG before reconsidering hardware.
final_statement: SOFTWARE_WINS is the conservative terminal closure. Software measurably removed most of the physical amplification and preserved exact correctness; the single integrated attempt was invalid before the state path, so no custom-hardware case, end-to-end software speedup, preservation break-even, or Amdahl gain is measured. Hardware interest does not survive and Experiment 005 is not generated.
